fusions.name: Folded Flock
fusions.desc: Launches 5 folded gliders in a fan, each dealing 4 damage. Your afflictions on a target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Penned Verdict
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 6 tiles away for 9 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Fresh Edition
fusions.desc: Increases your cast speed by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Blank Page
fusions.desc: The moment your mana is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
